subject.title: docs(reference): add Apple SpeechAnalyzer API knowledge-base page

question: Should OpenClaw own a standalone Apple SpeechAnalyzer SDK tutorial, or should this page be narrowed to the maintained OpenClaw/Swabble integration boundary?
rationale: Code review can correct stale paths, but it cannot decide whether the repository should permanently maintain this broad third-party API knowledge-base surface.

options.title: Narrow to OpenClaw
options.body: Keep the OpenClaw/Swabble workflow, supported use cases, troubleshooting, and authoritative Apple links while removing general SDK tutorial material OpenClaw does not own.

options.title: Accept broad reference
options.body: Merge the full tutorial only if documentation owners intentionally accept ongoing responsibility for its Apple API claims and runnable sample.

options.title: Keep tutorial external
options.body: Host the generic SDK guide with Swabble or another appropriate project and link it from OpenClaw documentation where relevant.

recommendation.title: Narrow to OpenClaw
recommendation.body: Keep the OpenClaw/Swabble workflow, supported use cases, troubleshooting, and authoritative Apple links while removing general SDK tutorial material OpenClaw does not own.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest available routing candidate because the page is framed around the Swabble implementation he introduced and repository-level documentation ownership is otherwise broad.
